chain.title: A Strange Ore
chain.desc: Mine the blue-pulsing vinteum ore found underground; every wand, altar, and spell in Mana and Artifice traces back to this one mineral.

chain.title: A Blue Powder
chain.desc: Smelt raw vinteum into dust and notice it clings to iron; this powder is the universal magical reagent you will be sprinkling into recipes for the rest of the mod.

chain.title: Magnetic Metal
chain.desc: Combine vinteum dust with an iron ingot; the dust fuses into the metal, and one more trip through the furnace finishes the job.

chain.title: Tracking Down Magic
chain.desc: Smelt the coated iron into a true vinteum ingot; villagers recognize this metal, and trading it is how you find your way into the arcane.

chain.title: The Codex Arcana
chain.desc: Trade a vinteum ingot to a villager for this book; reading it starts your magic XP bar, and everything from rituals to factions is documented inside it.

chain.title: Scribe
chain.desc: Build a Basic Table, an Animated Quill, and Vellum into this desk; here you design custom spells from a shape, components, and modifiers instead of learning fixed ones.

chain.title: Chalk the Circle
chain.desc: Craft chalk and drag it across the ground to draw ritual runes; rituals are how spells get created, tiers get ascended, and factions get joined, so keep a stick on you always.

chain.title: Your First Spell
chain.desc: Draw the Ritual of Arcana around your inscribed recipe to bind it into a castable spell, then cast it; casting anything is a Tier 1 Occulus task and levels your magic XP.

chain.title: Manamancer
chain.desc: A stick and a cap make a crude wand that traces manaweave patterns in the air; patterns are the second half of the mod's crafting language, so practice a few now.

chain.title: Manaweaver
chain.desc: Build this basin from arcane sandstone and a water bucket; drop items in and weave the right patterns above it to craft nearly every magical device from here on.

chain.title: Eyes on Ascension
chain.desc: Vinteum dust, glass, and an ornate table build your progression tracker; it lists the tasks for your current tier, and completing enough lets you perform the ascension ritual to Tier 2.

chain.title: Elementalist
chain.desc: Perform the Ritual of Forgotten Lore to condense an arcane mote, the heart of every mana crystal; its five elemental siblings (Searing Inferno, Deep Ocean, Endless Void, Untamed Wind, Ancient Stone) yield the fire, water, ender, air, and earth motes that faction rituals and Tier 2 tasks demand.

chain.title: Mana, Fused
chain.desc: Weave chimerite gems and purified vinteum dust into fragments, then eight fragments and an arcane mote into a full crystal; this is the battery block your casting economy runs on.

chain.title: Quicksilver
chain.desc: Weave a single square pattern over a copper ingot to transmute it; quicksilver is the metal of rune-working and gates the Runeforge, Runic Anvil, and Runescribing Table.

chain.title: The Runeforge
chain.desc: Assemble quicksilver, arcane stone, and stone glyphs into a forge; it heats metal for rune smithing, and later upgrades into a Brimstone Forge for level-III enchants.

chain.title: Runesmith
chain.desc: An anvil dressed with chimerite, quicksilver, and vinteum dust; hammer runes out of patterns here, repair broken mage armor, and eventually enchant gear directly with runes.

chain.title: Runecarver
chain.desc: Chisel rune patterns onto clay plates at this table; patterns are the templates the Runic Anvil forges from, and scribing your first rune checks off another Tier 2 task.

chain.title: A Reference System
chain.desc: Bind leather, paper, and string into a book that holds and hot-swaps your growing spell list; it is also a reagent for the Altar of Arcana and the Council's faction ritual.

chain.title: Student of Rote
chain.desc: Weave this desk and feed it Torn Journal Pages looted from wizard structures; rote practice lets you cast well-drilled spells for reduced mana, so it pays off on every fight after.

chain.title: Arcana Without the Chalk
chain.desc: Weave a spell book, chalk, animus dust, and a marking rune into this altar; it replaces the Ritual of Arcana entirely, letting you craft higher-complexity spells with no floor art.

chain.title: Pick a Patron
chain.desc: At Tier 3, perform a faction ritual: the Ancient Council, Faerie Courts, Demons of the Nether, or the Undead. Marks like this one drop from each faction's champions; allegiance unlocks faction spells, gear, and wellsprings.

chain.title: Kind of Like a Familiar
chain.desc: Weave this floating orb companion at Tier 3; it hovers at your shoulder and assists your casting, and crafting one is an Occulus task on the road to Tier 4.

chain.title: Transcriptionist
chain.desc: Woven at Tier 3: lay Manaweave patterns over a Basic Table with Wizard Chalk, two Bowls, Animus Dust and an Armor Stand. Once built, it scribes a rote-mastered spell onto glyphs, staves or construct arms, so allies and automatons cast your spells without you.

chain.title: Sanctum Invocation
chain.desc: Perform the Sanctum Invocation ritual and complete the structure it seeds; your sanctum is home turf that empowers your magic and is required progression at Tier 3.

chain.title: Claim a Wellspring
chain.desc: Brew a sight unguent or dowsing rod to find an eldrin wellspring, then capture it for your faction; pillars and conduits route its raw eldrin power to your workshop.

chain.title: The Eldrin Altar
chain.desc: Weave the Tier 4 altar that burns channeled wellspring power instead of items alone; greater motes, faction armor, horns, and every endgame recipe happen here.

chain.title: Eldrin Imbuement
chain.desc: Condense a greater mote at the Eldrin Altar using stored arcane power; greater motes are the currency of Tier 5 recipes and the Ritual of Odin's Call.

chain.title: The Allfather
chain.desc: At Tier 5, perform the Ritual of Odin's Call with witherbone and greater motes to summon Odin himself; survive his trial and he yields the Allfather's Axe.

chain.title: Arcane Crown
chain.desc: Weave the Tier 5 crown as proof you have mastered every system in the mod; wear it as the capstone of your ascent from a strange blue ore to archmage.

notes: Order taken from the mod's own data/mna/recipes/progression/tier_1..tier_4 gate recipes and data/mna/advancements/tier_0..tier_4 (author-authored tier ladder), cross-checked against recipe tier fields (manaweaving/eldrin_altar/runeforging recipes all carry explicit tier 1-5). Tier 0: vinteum ore -> dust -> coated iron -> ingot -> Codex via villager trade. Tier 1: inscription/ritual spellcraft + manaweaving. Tier 2: motes, mana crystals, rune-working, Altar of Arcana. Tier 3: faction join (mark items drop from faction champions: witch_hunter/spell_breaker/council_warden carry mark_of_the_council), sanctum, transcription. Tier 4: wellspring capture + Eldrin Altar + greater motes. Tier 5: Odin's Call ritual boss and faction endgame gear (collections). mark_of_the_council/mark_of_the_fey/mark_of_the_nether/mark_of_the_undead have no recipes - loot only. brimstone_charm (runeforge upgrade), modifier_book (Ritual of Alteration), and disenchanter were left to keep length at 29; all verified present if depth is later expanded.
